news.headline: The "Bendy Tree" Wins Tree of the Year
news.body: A 150-year-old elm tree in Northern Ireland was just named the UK's Tree of the Year. Strong winds from the sea pushed its trunk almost sideways, so people call it the "Bendy Tree." Its leafy branches now stretch over a seaside path and give people shade!

news.headline: Kids Talk to an Astronaut in Space by Radio
news.body: Students at a school in Scotland used a radio to talk live with astronaut Joshua Kutryk on the International Space Station. He told them that everything is hard in space, even brushing teeth! He also said astronauts play card games up there, just like people do on Earth.

news.headline: Happy 100th Birthday, Winnie-the-Pooh!
news.body: The very first Winnie-the-Pooh book came out 100 years ago, in 1926. To celebrate, the Royal Mail in the UK made new stamps showing Pooh, Piglet, Tigger, Eeyore, and their friends. Pooh's stories have been translated into about 80 languages!

fun_fact: Honeybees visit about 2 million flowers to make just one pound of honey. That's a lot of buzzing! 🐝
